Common questions

How many games will the New England Patriots win in 2026?

Across 10,000 simulated seasons the New England Patriots average 9.6 wins, with eight of every ten seasons between 7 and 12. Games already played count at their real result.

What are the New England Patriots' playoff odds?

They make the playoffs in 70% of simulated seasons, win the AFC East in 24% and earn the 1 seed in 8%, with every season seeded by the NFL's tiebreakers.

How is the Patriots simulation built?

Each remaining game is decided by that game's own win probability from the TrustMyRecord NFL model, the drive level model behind the NFL Simulator, and the season is replayed 10,000 times. The page is rebuilt twice a day from the latest schedule and results.
